name: The Wolf Who Cried Bunny
source:
Birth, the single event that determines the role you subsequently play for the rest of your life. Your fate is etched upon your skin, into your flesh, from the moment you are born. So what if you decide to rebel? What if you no longer abide by the rules Mother Nature imposed upon you? 

Rain, a wolf, hates their own wolfness — a predator who seeks not hunt. They always felt out of place among their pack, until one day, they met a rabbit who seemed to contradict her own nature just as they did... So what will happen when that bunny decides Rain is her favorite prey? 

[From [url=https://michikani.itch.io/the-wolf-who-cried-bunny]itch.io[/url]]
